title: Design System
seo: Dashboard design system and UI component library
meta: A shared set of buttons, forms, colors and layouts so every dashboard screen looks and works the same. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: A design system for a consistent dashboard
overview: When every screen has slightly different buttons and spacing, the product feels unfinished. We audit your current screens, then build one shared kit: colors, type sizes, spacing, buttons, form fields, tables, alerts and page layouts. Everything is coded as reusable components with usage notes, and where it helps we also provide a design file, so new screens come together faster and look the same.

faq: Do I need to start a new app to use this?
No. We build the kit on top of your current project and update screens one by one, so the app keeps working while it improves.
Which framework or style tools do you support?
React, Vue and plain CSS, with Tailwind or your current library if you use one. We match your stack so your team can maintain the components.
Will you change how my product looks?
We keep your brand colors and logo. The aim is consistency, not a new identity. If you want a visual redesign, tell us and we scope it separately.
Can you give me a Figma file too?
Yes in the Premium package. You keep the file, and it mirrors the coded components so designers and developers share the same pieces.
